name: yachay-ayacucho
description: Sistema web de turismo y patrimonio cultural de Huamanga, Ayacucho

scripts.docker:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
scripts.db:seed: pnpm db:seed:demo && pnpm db:seed:lugares && pnpm db:seed:rutas && pnpm db:seed:resenas
scripts.db:seed:demo: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U postgres -d huamanga -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f /seed/seed_demo.sql
scripts.db:seed:lugares: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U postgres -d huamanga -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f /seed/seed_lugares.sql
scripts.db:seed:rutas: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U postgres -d huamanga -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f /seed/seed_rutas.sql
scripts.db:seed:resenas: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U postgres -d huamanga -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f /seed/seed_resenas.sql
scripts.db:studio: docker compose exec postgres psql -U postgres -d huamanga
